The measurability hypotheses are the paper's standing assumption (the seminorm is only applied to Hessians of Sobolev functions); without them the statement is false, since Lean's `∫⁻` is only superadditive on non-measurable integrands (e.g. indicators of a Bernstein set and its complement).
